name: Zepho
title: Descendants of Esau
summary: Zepho was a descendant of Esau through Timna, the concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the tribal chiefs of Edom. Zepho represents part of Edom's early tribal structure and family history.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Seir's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Zepho is listed as one of the sons of Sobal, son of Seir the Horite, in the genealogy of Edom's inhabitants.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the sons of Seir in the land of Edom
keyEvents.description: In the overview of Seir's sons who lived in the land of Edom, Zepho is mentioned as part of Sobal's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Zepho is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles in connection with the genealogies of Edom, highlighting his place in biblical history.

keyEvents.title: Horite tribal chiefs in the land of Seir
keyEvents.description: The genealogy shows that the Horites, including Zepho and his family, were the original inhabitants of the land of Seir before Esau's descendants took over the area.
